status: DRAFT, batch 2 of CODEC-V2-PLAN: authored against the deixis-codec-v2 CANDIDATE CONTRACT. Not frozen; a contract change before the freeze invalidates these octets, which are then re-derived, not patched.
source: CODEC.md v2 as merged on main at b42d777 (malformed_slot_codec_id; F1-F3; F4 and first-use precision)
why_loses_to_naive_is_recorded: A precedence case is only worth writing if a plausible implementation gets it wrong. loses_to_naive names the code the obvious strategy produces, so each case states the defect it would catch.

vacuous_pairs.uvarint_overflow vs non_shortest_uvarint: mutually exclusive; §10 records it as unexercisable
vacuous_pairs.duplicate_key vs unsorted_keys: mutually exclusive; §10 records it as unexercisable
vacuous_pairs.unexpected_eof vs trailing_bytes: mutually exclusive; §10 records it as unexercisable

holding: Every decoding case states `holding`: the base slot-codec ids the decoder holds for that case (§2.1's modifier, stated with the ids it ranges over as §16 requires). option-of over a held id is held (§13). The harness decoder holds 00 01 and the fixture setoid's id unless a case says otherwise.
